title: Guard one real instant of remembrance
summary: One moment of true remembrance steadies more than endless drift. Choose the practice that leaves the heart steadier, not louder.
takeaway: Choose the practice that leaves the heart steadier, not louder.
lifeApplication: Before the next app, errand, or anxious leap, close the lips and give one unbroken instant to Naam. Let one true pause interrupt the drift.

source.shortMeaning: One moment of true remembrance steadies more than endless drift.
